channel.title: S.W. Ogden's Blog
channel.description: New posts from S.W. Ogden (Stephen Wesley Ogden) on biblical studies, apologetics, and the stories behind his books.

item.title: Writing the Woman Who Never Speaks: Lot's Wife in Salt
item.description: She's never named in Genesis - so I named her, hid it from the reader, and quietly tied her story to Ruth's.

item.title: Quick Trivia: Which Church Age Sounds Like Today?
item.description: A two-minute checklist from Revelation 3 - see which church age sounds like a church you've actually sat in.

item.title: The Church Ages: Why Seven, Why These Seven Messengers
item.description: Seven stars in the right hand of Christ, seven ages of church history, and the seven men held to carry them.

item.title: One Verse, One Minute: 1 Kings 19:12
item.description: A sixty-second close read of the verse at the center of Elijah's story - and the Hebrew word most translations soften.

item.title: Elijah's Silence: What God Didn't Say on the Mountain
item.description: Revisiting the still small voice - and what the silence itself was actually saying.

item.title: 3 Manuscript Facts Readers Find Surprising
item.description: A quick companion piece to Monday's post - short, sharp, and worth the two-minute read.

item.title: Why the Bible's Manuscript Evidence Still Holds Up
item.description: A look at what actually survives from antiquity - and why it matters more than most readers realize.
